copy: Publishing is off for this workspace.
Ask a workspace owner to turn it on. A missing Vercel connection is a different state.
Nothing on this screen can turn it on.

targets.name: Publish · unavailable (feature off) — the shipping panel prints the VERCEL copy in this state instead (PublishTab.tsx:336 noPublishPath, :436 'Connect Vercel to publish.'), while the topbar says 'Publishing isn't switched on for this workspace yet' (lifecycle.ts:104-109). Two mutually exclusive reasons for one state; the missing-connection state has its own board now (UX-E-04)
